turns.q: Maadi or Zamalek, which flat is better for us?
turns.a:
<react>🤔</react><say>Good one. Maadi wins on money, Zamalek on time.</say>
## The two flats

| | Maadi | Zamalek |
|---|---|---|
| Rent | $1,400 | $1,800 |
| Commute | 45 min | 15 min |
| Deposit | 2 months | 1 month |

```options
Maadi | $1,400 | Garden flat, quieter | Bigger, but the commute takes an hour and a half a day | pick: cheaper and calmer
Zamalek | $1,800 | City flat | Close to work and to friends
```

The rent goes up 10% in April ([Call with the landlord](share:receipt?title=Call+with+the+landlord&kind=voice&t=95000)).

turns.q: How am I doing on my food budget this month?
turns.a:
You're on track: **$312 of $600** with 18 days gone, a little under an even pace.

```openui
root = Card([spent, days, weeks, split, top, table], "Food this month")
spent = Progress("Spent so far", 312, 600, "$", "less", 18 / 31, "Today", "About " + @Money(@Round((600 - 312) / (31 - 18)), "$") + " a day keeps you inside it")
```
